content: Yeso ka lyǝ aa Urushalima
Nangka Yeso kaa atoma kai ne dukǝ kapeng ka Betapaji kamea ka amara ka Urushalima, ba kulǝ oyara o mati ma Zaitun, na Yeso ka tong atoma kai a leere,
naka beka nee na, “Lyǝ na ba kapeng kaa niini ba izi oying. Ee lyǝ eyo laka kurungzǝ baa tera, ka kabana kame. Dinggǝ na e ka ecang.
Ondo wa pirkǝ, ying e beka wai na, Ateokora ya yeme one. Wayo kuriyǝ ee aa rabokoro.”
A ye nyimia adorana a panza epa eeka ondo beya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili Zakariya beke obena,

content.text: laka, Ogomo oying waya zo deya ba ying!

content: Na atoma Yeso ne ale, nane ye epaaka Yeso ka bekaa ne.
Nane de kaa kurungzǝ ka kabana kame, nane nata ne madibi aa zaa one, a ka zale.
Na aromo ba cak ne nata madibi mane ba zaa orona, aana ondo gera marane ma mati nane eese ba zaa orona.
A okurkǝnǝng aromo ka neya teweno ba izi ka kai kaa andaaka neya dimǝ kai, nane ara angmelo aane beya na,

content.text: o kando ko deya ba nyimi leze le Ateokora!

content: Nangka Yeso ka lyǝ baa nyimi Urushalima na pate apeng me a bitǝkǝrnu, aane beya naa, “Mana waana?”
Na aromo aaka neya tare o Yeso bekaana, “Kanna kando ka o beya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili Yeso kamea ka surǝa Nazarat o makeke ma Galili.”
Yeso ka tarangga ana ejamane aa akwilǝ Ashili
Na Yeso ka lyǝ akwilǝ Ashili naka tarangga ana o lisǝzǝ kaa ana o eesa magogoro baa nyimi me, naka bitǝkǝri pate matara mana o saara emate me, kaa matara ma o lisǝsǝ egoma e akwilǝ.
Naka bekaa nee na, “A wele obena,

content.text: ‘Ayo rara akwilǝ ang aro beya angmǝ kaa Ashili,
na ying e kuriyǝ ai aro baasaza ana o tǝǝru aromo.’ ”

content: Na arǝ kaa agǝdǝ ne deya baa kai a nyimi akwilǝ Ashili naka womza ne.

Nangka andaamoole magame ma Ashili, kaa ana o baala angmǝ aka Ashili a nya Mosa ne laka epa o tera ukpwei eeka ka eza, aa ayana yaa saba Ashili ba nyimi akwilǝ Ashili a ne beya na, “Hosana Kena ka Daoda!” Na ne kone oburǝ maleo.
Nane bekaa kai na, “Oya konaza epaeka andaana ya beya me sang? Na Yeso beka ne naa, “Ma kona, azaa nyimi eta rosa obena a wele na,

content.text: “Ba nyimi ongmǝ a abana ayana kaa akaa tata a asa,
boa baa ote ka ne saboo sang?”

content: Naka arnang kaa ne, aaka suri ba nyimi apeng me, naka ale ba Betanya, aaka more saname.
Yeso ka ye uti o ulǝ angmǝ
Nangka ara a sane a kaya kurǝ ba nyimia apeng, na ekomo moke kai.
Nangka ka laka uti o uli ba ting orona, naka ale ba uti me naka ta cǝ eyapa o uti me ne soona marane belle. Naka beka uti me na, “Otoo ya ayana kangza ne!” Na ongmere liizi na uti me wa waka.
Nangka atoma kai ne laka nyimi, na epame e tere ne ukpwei nane bore be pirǝ na, “Eyaka uti uli na wa waka ba saseya?”

Na Yeso ka kabare naka beka ne naa, “Eyang dongdong bele oying maganggang maame, eeya ka o eke lenyong ba Ashili, zora madoola ma yende, epaaka e mana uti uli ona, eya eto eza belle ne, eyo ama o beka ba oyara ona, era, ka o taru ba nyimi opong ogong, a wayo itǝ nyimi.
Eeya ka o eke lenyong ba Ashili, pate epaaka e bosa ba Ashili eyo cǝ e.”
Aya masanggo azaa o bare o Yeso

Nangka Yeso ka lyǝ ba nyimi akwilǝ Ashili, kaya aza obaala naname, na andaamoole magame ma Ashili, ka magonggong ma aromo nane deya kai ka be pirǝ na, “Ka legoone le mana oya eza magogoro maana? Kangza mana wa nyau legoone le me?”
Na Yeso ka kabare naka bekaa na, “Mima eyang eza o ying be pirǝ. E kabareng, mima eyang bele oying ka legoone le mana ang eze magogoro maana.
O batisma o Yohana, wa surǝ babaa? Ba zaa shili naa, ba aromoi?” Nane dambaraza a tukpwei tone obena, “Te bekaana, wa surǝ shili, kayo bekaa aro na, na eyaka eta e kabare kaa kai ne?”
Kangza te bekaana, “Wa surǝ ba aromo, teya kona boome be aromo, obena komana wa rose obena Yohana ondo beya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili wai.”
Nane kabare Yeso na, “Teta rosa ne.” Na Yeso beka ne naa, “Nyimia mima anta a bele oying ka legoone le mana ang ezeze magogoro maana ne.”
Angmǝ a gerpo azaa ayana leere
“E laka nannia? Oromo yende wa zene kaa ayana leere andaleme. Nawa ale baa ka o bora, nawa beka kai na, “Kena kang ale ka o eza ogole ba ara o inabi.
Na kena kame beka na, “Anta ale ne.” Nangka a rabokoro naka sara madoola, aaka ale.
Na ate ame wa ale baa ka o leere kame, nawa beka kai epaaka wa beka a ka o bora. Na ka o leere bekaana, “Ma kona ate, eyang ale,” na kata ale ne.

Ba nyimi ayana leere me mana wa ye epaeka ate me wa yeme? Nane bekaana, “Ka o bora.” Na Yeso bekaa nee na, “Eyang bele o ying epeng eme, ana o eesa emate e makeke kaa andaaye o lisǝzǝ apung ane neya kaana oying o lyǝ ba togomo ta Ashili.

Obena Yohana o batisma wa de nawa wore ying orona o rere, neeta kabare ka wai ne. Ba zaa nyimi na ana o eesa emate makeke kaa andaaye o lisǝzǝ apung ane ne kabare ka wai, aa ying pate ka o laka enna, malo nyimi na eta kabare a pisǝ madinǝ maying ne.”
Angmǝ aa gerpo azaa ana ogoleara ka neye kaa araa buru

“Angmǝ aa gerpo yendea aana kangza. Oromo yende wa zene ka waye kaa ara o inabi, nawa ringǝri ara me ka odarne, nawa kau le'o le noke ayana inabi a ara me, a kangza wa so odankee ona soola ara me. Malo nyimi nawa nya ana ogole yende lebose le ara me, a wa ale begere.
Nangka awere o sende e inabi me wa ye, nawa tong azara wai baa ana ogole me kane embe epaaka e itǝ e wai baa ne.
Na andaaka a bose ne ara me, ne meke azara me, nane ole o yende, aa ne wong o yende, aa ne teeze o taaro me.
Nawa kang tongha azara yende, amea ne kala obora, na andaaka a bose ne ara me, nane ye ne epaeka ne ye ana obora name.
Malo nyimi nawa tong kena ka wai baa ne, a wa eke obena, ‘Neyo laka o gongha kena kang.’
Nangka andaaka a bose ne ara ame ne laka kena ka oromo me, nane bekaa tukpwei tone na, “Aha, kando kaana ekeeya ara me aya itǝ a kai. A te wongha kai adorana ara me itǝ a aro.”
Na ne moke kai, aane tare kai ba malo o darne, nane wongha kai.
O ara aana wa deya, eya wayo ya kaa andaaka a bose ne ara ogole me?”
Nane beka kai na, “Wayo wongza ana anyong a buru me, awa bose ana ondo a ara me, andaaka neyo nyaza wai epaaka e itǝ e wai aa nyimi epa eeka ne cǝ.”
Na Yeso beka ne naa, “Eta tukǝ kona epaaka a wele ba nyimi angmǝ Ashili sang? O bena,

content.text: leya lee itǝ le o kala ee dang o sowa odo.
Epa o tera ukpwei aa yizi aro.”

content: “Ba zaa nyimi eyang bele oying, ayo emba togomo ta Ashili ba ying, ka nya a aromo makeke ma yende amea neyo wore o cikǝ o rere.
Ondooka wa rizi aza le cale leena, wayo poso. Aa ondooka le cale leme le taru ba zaa wai leyo nyanta wai naa ma'ena.”
Nangka ana magame ma moole kaa maParisa ne kone angmǝ me, nane rose obena, kaya beya baa za onea.
Na ne gere o moke okai, na boome ba aromo nara ne, obena pate aromo ne jeka kai ondo beya angmǝ kama mawo ma Ashili kai.
